strategy: I exploit the exemption on private commuter vehicles by running an informal last-mile relay service using my personal older petrol scooter. Commercial delivery vans drop bulk parcels just outside the inner core cordon boundary before 7 AM or at the perimeter to avoid the $5/km tax, and I pick up individual consignments for a small cash markup to deliver inside the zone throughout the day. By replacing consolidated van deliveries with dozens of fragmented, inefficient trips on an uninspected personal two-wheeler, I pocket the delivery surcharge margin while circumventing commercial classification entirely.
